not_this_screen: These are published Fama/French portfolios. They are not assign_signal, composite_value, or the FTSE paper books.

us_four_leg_value_blend_minus_market.note: Each month, the average of the Hi-30 book-to-market, earnings/price, cashflow/price and dividend-yield portfolios, minus the CRSP market. Value-weight is the large-cap mix. Equal-weight is closer to a broad buy tier.

uk_local_value_weight.universe_note: MSCI country portfolios 1975-2006, Bloomberg thereafter. Value-weighted. Weaker on delisted names than the US CRSP sorts.
